$sources: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 7 (snow loads): Sec 7.2 ground snow loads by risk category, 7.3 flat roof snow load, 7.4 sloped roofs, 7.7-7.8 drifts

sources.flatFactor: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.3, Eq 7.3-1: pf = 0.7 Ce Ct pg (pg of the risk category's map, Sec 7.2; no importance factor)
sources.exposure: ASCE 7-22 Table 7.3-1, Ce by surface roughness B, C, D and above the tree line / Alaska without trees, and roof exposure
sources.thermal: ASCE 7-22 Table 7.3-2, Ct by thermal condition (the categories of the earlier edition; see VERIFY.md)
sources.slope: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.4, Figure 7.4-1: Cs for warm roofs (Ct <= 1.0), cold roofs Ct = 1.1 and Ct >= 1.2
sources.minimum: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.3.3: low-slope roofs (below 15 degrees), pm = pg up to 20 psf (0.96 kN/m²), 20 psf above
sources.drift: ASCE 7-22 Sec 7.8, Eq 7.8-1 (leeward drift with the winter wind parameter W2), windward drift 3/4 of it with the lower roof's length, w = 4 hd, hd <= hc with w = 4 hd²/hc <= 8 hc; lu at least 20 ft
sources.seismicShare: ASCE 7-22 Sec 12.7.2(4): 20 % of the uniform design snow load where the flat roof snow load exceeds 30 psf (1.44 kN/m²)
